description: The logging interceptor (log_tool_call) never blocks the tool execution return path; it uses try_read for circuit breaker check and try_send for channel dispatch, returning immediately regardless of outcome

preconditions.description: A tool execution completes and log_tool_call is invoked

expectedOutcome.description: log_tool_call returns in < 5ms without awaiting any async operation; if channel is full or circuit breaker is open, the record is dropped silently
